svg.aria-label: NACS 22.9 percent of new builds doubled, but only 8 percent of installed base. CCS still 70.8 percent new, 74.6 percent base.
svg.text: NACS vs CCS: New Builds vs Installed Base (Paren Q2 2026)
New non-Tesla connectors: NACS 22.9% (800) · CCS 70.8% (2,471) · CHAdeMO 6.3%
Source: Paren Q2 2026 (806 new stations). Installed base 48,371 non-Tesla DCFC ports.
Takeaway: mixed-connector infra for years. Adapters + dual-standard stalls mandatory.
